name: Thunderbird
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Thunderbird as the default Omarchy mail client — all 22 stock themes, privacy defaults, system-wide mailto registration.

features: 22 Omarchy themes via userChrome.css with automatic switching on omarchy theme set
Privacy defaults: remote content blocked, telemetry off
Sets Thunderbird as default mail client at user, system XDG, and Omarchy levels
Sane UI defaults: wide layout, threaded view, date-descending sort
Starts at login and opens on workspace 4 (silent — does not steal focus)
